answer: Require each new identity to be vouched for by an established, non-kin agent: the voucher locks 400 units and the recruit locks 200, and both are slashed if the recruit is proven fake. A voucher may back at most three recruits per epoch, so each extra fake consumes one slot and puts 600 units at risk; a farm needs a new voucher and stake for every fake. This cost cannot be shared, bulk-bought, or parallelized away, because the cap binds each voucher per epoch and the voucher's standing is on the line. On a tundra of free keys, a willow claim alone cannot cross the ocean of verified work.
